title: The merge tool prints a reason for an unread or refused cite
why: A cite the merge tool refuses or cannot read today stops it with no reason, so the reader cannot fix it.
note: Retires the note of the same name. Also adds the `actions: read` line to action.yml. Stacked on #1712 (silent-undo-ci-body). Filed from the coordinator, 19:26 CST Nov 7.
